description: This file provides a detailed implementation of a configuration class for interfacing with Databricks' chat API, including methods for transforming messages, converting tools, handling responses, and managing streaming data. It essentially adapts OpenAI-like chat interactions to Databricks' API specifications, implementing request/response parsing, content extraction, and response iteration logic.
